why: The pilot's direction, decided card by card in discussion on 2026-10-05: steam after T7-8 (logs 001/003/006: out of gas, wipe after wipe, rebuilding small blockers) is the objective; full Mardu leaning RED; life gain as strong as the drain; BRACKET 4 BUILT FOR the Conqueror+Vito loop (Exquisite Blood as the second, wipe-proof Conqueror-half; Marauding Blight-Priest; Demonic/Enlightened/Diabolic Intent). Draw split per strategy:card-advantage.plan-draw: steady (Phyrexian Arena, Cosmos Elixir) + on-plan wipe insurance (Erebos, Bleak-Hearted). Starters: Tithe Drinker, Wispdrinker Vampire, Edgar Ancient Bloodlord. Red tier: Bloodtithe Harvester, Olivia Voldaren, Falkenrath Aristocrat, Olivia Crimson Bride, Strefan. Mana: four fetches into Blood Crypt/Godless Shrine + Rakdos/Orzhov Signet (mana-fit: B 31->35+, R 19->21+). 1-drops trimmed, flat lords cut (pilot's rule). Keeper and Vish Kal stay. Objective is draw-v1's line so the two are comparable; Forge is a probe, not a gate.
